invariants.rationale: Returned map should never be null; it is always initialized before returning.
The only possible key in the result is PLAN_STRATEGY_SORT_COLUMNS.key() if sort columns are present; otherwise, the map is empty.
At most one entry is put into the map based on the given code.
result contains PLAN_STRATEGY_SORT_COLUMNS.key() if and only if it is not empty.
